result.instructions: Tools for Linga POS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which stores are on my Linga POS account?"; "Show the sale summary for store 5c5981496bcf7500013afeb0 for last 7 days."; "List the active menu items of my main store.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Linga POS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run lingapos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lingapos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lingapos_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. lingapos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lingapos_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List the stores on the Linga POS account, with their ids. Start here to find a store_id for the other tools. Linga API: GET /store/.

tools.name: lingapos_get_store
tools.title: Get a store
tools.description: Get one store's details by store id. Linga API: GET /store/{store-id}.

tools.name: lingapos_list_menu_items
tools.title: List menu items
tools.description: List the menu items of one store (items sold on the POS), optionally only active or only inactive ones. Linga API: GET /store/{store-id}/menuItems.

active.description: true = active items only, false = inactive items only. Omit for all.

tools.name: lingapos_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers saved on the Linga POS account (loyalty and contact records). Linga API: GET /customers.

tools.name: lingapos_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer record by customer id. Linga API: GET /customer/{customer-id}.

tools.name: lingapos_sale_summary_report
tools.title: Sale summary report
tools.description: Read the sale summary report of one store for a date range (totals of sales). Linga API: GET /store/{store-id}/saleSummaryReport.

date_option.description: Date range: T today, Y yesterday, LND last N days (needs number_of_days), W this week, L7D last 7 days, M this month, LM last month, L30D last 30 days, SD one specific date (needs specific_date), DR date range (needs from_date and to_date).

number_of_days.description: Days back, for date option LND.

specific_date.description: Date for date option SD, format dd-Mon-yyyy (for example 29-Sep-2019).

from_date.description: Start date for date option DR, format dd-Mon-yyyy.

to_date.description: End date for date option DR, format dd-Mon-yyyy.

tools.name: lingapos_transaction_report
tools.title: Transaction report
tools.description: Read the transactions report of one store for a date range (payments and tenders). Linga API: GET /store/{store-id}/transactionReport.

date_option.description: Date range: T today, Y yesterday, LND last N days (needs number_of_days), W this week, L7D last 7 days, M this month, LM last month, L30D last 30 days, SD one specific date (needs specific_date), DR date range (needs from_date and to_date).

number_of_days.description: Days back, for date option LND.

specific_date.description: Date for date option SD, format dd-Mon-yyyy (for example 29-Sep-2019).

from_date.description: Start date for date option DR, format dd-Mon-yyyy.

to_date.description: End date for date option DR, format dd-Mon-yyyy.

tools.name: lingapos_get_sale
tools.title: Get a sale
tools.description: Get the details of one sale (order) by sale id. Find the sale id in a sale report. Linga API: GET /sale/{sale-id}/getSale.
